limitation_notes: Prior chat history and the shared ChatGPT link were not available as local source text; this JSON uses the uploaded PDF, existing Rulebook.txt, and explicit scrutiny requirements in this request.

Where user-stated LDA scrutiny practice is stricter than extracted PDF text, it is encoded as an LDA scrutiny/amendment policy check and should be verified by Regulations/Legal before production enforcement.

definitions.clause_text: Residential Building means a building exclusively designed to be used for human habitation together with such out houses as are ordinarily ancillary to the main building and used in connection therewith.
Porch means a roof cover supported on pillars or cantilevered projection for the purpose of pedestrian or vehicular approach to a building.
Mandatory Open Spaces means the spaces required by these Regulations to be left open at ground level around the building.
Right of way means width of road/street between two opposite property lines.

chapter_2_residential_site_requirements.clause_title: Established built-up areas; roads up to 25 ft ROW
chapter_2_residential_site_requirements.clause_text: For a building abutting on roads having up to 25 ft right of way the building line shall be as established by existing buildings, while side and rear spaces are governed by the table at 2.1.1(b).

For buildings abutting roads having more than 25 ft right of way, mandatory open spaces are prescribed by plot size: less than 5 Marla front 5 ft, rear not required, side not required; 5 to under 10 Marla front 5 ft, rear 5 ft, side not required; 10 to 30 Marla front 10 ft, rear 7 ft, side 5 ft on one side; above 30 Marla to under 2 Kanal front 10 ft, rear 7 ft, side 5 ft both sides; 2 Kanal and above front 20 ft, rear 10 ft, side 10 ft both sides.

chapter_2_residential_site_requirements.clause_title: Permissible unroofed items in mandatory spaces
chapter_2_residential_site_requirements.clause_text: Drain, sewer, septic tank, cess pool, filter, waste-liquid disposal structure, open garden tank or private swimming pool may be permissible in mandatory open spaces provided that no roofed building is attached.
Residential buildings other than apartment buildings shall follow Clause 2.2.3 height/storey limits. Minimum clear height of each storey other than basement shall not be less than 9 ft 6 in.

For ROW above 25 ft apply approved-scheme FAR and coverage. For ROW up to 25 ft: less than 5 Marla 85% and FAR 2.0; 5 to under 10 Marla 80% and FAR 1.6; 10 Marla to under 1 Kanal 70% and FAR 1.5; 1 Kanal to under 2 Kanal 65% and FAR 1.4; 2 Kanal and above 60% and FAR 1.3.

Car porch not exceeding 20 ft in length is permissible in side space. In corner plots car porch is permissible along longer side. Where minimum 5 ft side space is required, construction of a room over the car porch equal to its area is also permissible.
A toilet/bathroom not exceeding 40 sq ft in area and 8 ft in height can be constructed in the rear corner towards the dead wall as an integral part of main building.

Approved scheme table: less than 5 Marla front 5 ft, rear 5 ft, side not required; 5 to under 10 Marla front 5 ft, rear 5 ft, side not required; 10 to 30 Marla front 10 ft, rear 7 ft, side 5 ft one side; above 30 Marla to under 2 Kanal front 10 ft, rear 7 ft, side 5 ft both sides; 2 Kanal to under 4 Kanal front 20 ft, rear 10 ft, side 10 ft both sides; 4 Kanal and above front 20 ft, rear 13 ft, side 13 ft both sides.

chapter_2_residential_site_requirements.clause_title: Coverage, FAR, height, storeys and parking
chapter_2_residential_site_requirements.clause_text: Less than 5 Marla: 3 storeys, 80%, 38 ft, FAR 2.4. 5 to under 10 Marla: 3 storeys, 75%, 38 ft, FAR 2.3. 10 Marla to under 1 Kanal: 3 storeys, 70%, 45 ft, FAR 2.8. 1 Kanal to 30 Marla: 3 storeys, 65%, 45 ft, FAR 2.6. Above 30 Marla to under 2 Kanal: 3 storeys, 60%, 45 ft, FAR 2.4. 2 Kanal and above: 3 storeys, 55%, 45 ft, FAR 2.2. Basement is included in FAR. Structural stability certificate, structure drawings and calculations are required above 38 ft and must be vetted by Structural Engineer on LDA panel.

chapter_2_residential_site_requirements.clause_title: Predominantly open areas mandatory open spaces
chapter_2_residential_site_requirements.clause_text: Permissible building line shall be as provided in Clause 2.2.1. Other mandatory spaces by frontage: less than 30 ft rear 5 ft, side not required; 30 ft to 50 ft rear 5 ft, side 5 ft both sides; above 50 ft to 70 ft rear 10 ft, side 5 ft both sides; above 70 ft rear 10 ft, side 10 ft both sides.

A part not exceeding 25% of floor area of a residential building may be used, subject to formal competent-authority permission, as an office associated with the resident professional, subject to qualification, registration, and ownership/NOC requirements.
No pillar construction is allowed for residential building/house/farm house; concealed column for strengthening may be allowed keeping in view bearing capacity of soil.
No billboard and hoardings shall be allowed on residential plots.

chapter_2_residential_site_requirements.clause_title: Basement separate plan on 60 ft and above ROW
chapter_2_residential_site_requirements.clause_text: Plots abutting on 60 ft and above right of way require separate plans for basement to be submitted and sanctioned.
Rainwater invert well/tank provision is required for houses above 5 Marla, and adequate grating shall be provided within plot line to prevent rainwater from flowing onto the road.
Underground and overhead water tanks are required for residential buildings having area of 3 Marla and above.

No building plan shall be approved more than 3 storeys. Violations in mandatory spaces are non-compoundable. Removal of partition walls without LDA approval may result in plan cancellation/revocation.

chapter_5_internal_space_and_ventilation.clause_text: Basement minimum room height shall be 8 ft. Residential/commercial basement minimum area shall be 100 sq ft and shall be constructed after leaving required mandatory open spaces. Foundations shall not intrude into adjoining properties.
Minimum area of a room meant for human habitation shall be 100 sq ft with minimum width of 8 ft.
Minimum floor area of a kitchen shall be 50 sq ft with minimum width of 6 ft.
Minimum height of any habitable room from finished floor level to ceiling shall not be less than 9 ft 6 in.

Every room other than storage rooms shall have combined glazed area not less than 8% of floor space unless mechanical arrangement is provided; 50% of such openings shall allow free uninterrupted passage of air.

Every toilet, water closet, urinal stall and bathroom shall have daylight and ventilation by openings in external walls with combined area not less than 2 sq ft per water closet, urinal stall or bathroom.

Kitchens, toilets, water closets and bathrooms may have daylight/ventilation from internal air wells. Up to 2 storeys: minimum air-well area 50 sq ft and minimum width 6 ft. From 3 to 7 storeys: minimum area 100 sq ft and minimum width 8 ft. Air-well floor shall have impervious paving, drainage, access at bottom, and shall not be roofed except with fiberglass or similar material.

chapter_10_sanctioning_and_use_control.clause_text: Every builder carrying out building works within LDA jurisdiction shall comply with these Building Regulations.

chapter_10_sanctioning_and_use_control.clause_title: Use consistent with Master Plan/approved scheme
chapter_10_sanctioning_and_use_control.clause_text: No land or building shall be used in a manner inconsistent with the use prescribed in any Master Plan and Approved Scheme as applicable, or converted under applicable commercialization rules, or in violation of these Building Regulations.

Building works increasing covered area or altering original use of rooms require application to Authority on BR-1/BR-2. Addition/alteration plans shall show additions/alterations in red, existing work in black, and structures to be demolished in yellow.

Minimum first-phase residential floor area for completion: 3 Marla 250 sft, 5 Marla 300 sft, 7 Marla 350 sft, 10 Marla 375 sft, 12 Marla 450 sft, 1 Kanal 750 sft, 2 Kanal and above 1250 sft. Minimum floor area shall include at least one habitable room, latrine, bathroom and kitchen.

major_road_residential_outlook.trigger: road_width_ft > 50 or plot falls on declared main road
major_road_residential_outlook.required_outlook: Design must clearly read as a residential house and not facilitate commercial, apartment, hostel, guest-house or mixed-use future use.
non_compliance_indicators: large shop-like front openings or shutter bays
separate independent access to each floor inconsistent with single house
excessive toilets without residential room logic
front parking layout resembling customer parking
absence of family lounge/drawing/dining/kitchen residential logic
major_road_residential_outlook.standard_objection_text: The plot falls on a main road/road above 50 ft width and the submitted design does not clearly confirm residential outlook and future residential use. Revise frontage, circulation and room-use arrangement strictly as a residential house under Clause 10.1(b).

auto_objection_templates.text: The submitted DWG file does not conform to the prescribed LDA 42-layer residential house CAD standard. Submit revised DWG using prescribed layers or acceptable equivalent layer names.

The drawing is not arranged according to LDA residential house submission layout. Lower half must contain Basement, Ground Floor, First Floor, Second Floor and Applicant/Coverage boxes, and upper half must contain site plan, elevation, sections, OHWT/UGWT/rainwater and related details.
Mandatory open spaces/building lines are deficient. Revise front, rear and side spaces according to the applicable residential site requirement clause.
Ground coverage/FAR exceeds the permissible limit for the plot size. Revise covered areas and applicant coverage table according to the applicable clause.
Minimum internal building requirements are deficient. Habitable rooms, kitchens, basement rooms and inter-floor arrangements must comply with Clause 5.2.
OTS/patio/internal air well is deficient. Provide minimum area and width according to number of storeys and keep it open-to-sky/drained as required.
Bath/toilet over or on car porch is not acceptable under LDA residential house scrutiny. Toilet/bathroom provision must comply with Clause 2.1.5 and may not be treated as porch coverage.

auto_objection_templates.condition: second floor coverage over porch in side space
auto_objection_templates.text: Coverage over car porch/side mandatory space at second-floor level is not acceptable under LDA residential house scrutiny. Remove the proposed coverage and keep mandatory side space compliant.

auto_objection_templates.condition: main road >50 ft residential outlook not confirmed
auto_objection_templates.text: The plot falls on a main road/road above 50 ft width and the submitted design does not clearly confirm residential outlook and future residential use. Revise frontage, circulation and room-use arrangement strictly as a residential house under Clause 10.1(b).

auto_objection_templates.condition: separate basement plan missing for 60 ft+ ROW
auto_objection_templates.text: For plot abutting road having 60 ft and above right of way, separate basement plan is required. Submit basement plan separately for scrutiny/sanction where basement is proposed.

approval_conditions: Building shall be constructed strictly according to approved residential house plan.
Building shall be used strictly for residential purpose only and not as commercial, apartment, hostel, guest house or mixed use.
No alteration/removal of partition walls or change in use shall be made without prior LDA approval.
Mandatory open spaces shall remain open; violations are non-compoundable.
Basement, if separately released, shall not constitute approval of upper floors unless separately sanctioned.
UGWT/OHWT, rainwater, drainage and energy-efficiency provisions shall be implemented where applicable.
Final decision remains subject to competent authority, site verification and applicable amendments/circulars.
